papers.title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
papers.authors: Hanzhang Zhou, Panrong Tong, Xu Zhang, Quyu Kong, Chenglin Cai, Tianyu Xia, Gongjie Zhang, Jianan Zhang, Long Li, Long Chen, Lei Wang, Gaole Dai, Pengxiang Li, Liangyu Chen, Yue Wang, Steven Hoi
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Token Hub, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 本文提出Qwen-UI-Agent，一个以真实世界为中心的通用GUI基础代理，通过大规模真实设备移动环境、混合GUI+CLI动作空间、自动化数据飞轮和在线强化学习，在移动、桌面、网页和DeepSearch任务上取得了领先或极具竞争力的性能。

papers.title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
papers.authors: Yash Pandya, Sahil Gupta, Sarthak Harne, Archana Yadav, Kavyansh Chourasia, Hussein Mozannar, Vibhav Vineet, Sara Abdali, Corby Rosset, Yash Lara, Ahmed Awadallah, Ece Kamar, Akshay Nambi
papers.affiliations: Microsoft Research（其中 Sahil Gupta 和 Archana Yadav 标注为在 Microsoft Research 工作期间完成，通讯作者 Akshay Nambi 邮箱 akshayn@microsoft.com）
papers.intro: Echoverse 提出一种将环境构建与模型训练统一为共同进化过程的路线：通过从目标工作流反向构建“深”的环境，并利用每次评分的轨迹同时修复环境、任务、验证器和训练模型，使一个9B模型在14个评测分割上从36.5%提升到67.1%，接近教导它的更大规模前沿模型。

papers.title: VidMap: Exploiting Temporal Structure for Video-Based Structure-from-Motion
papers.authors: Zador Pataki, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Marc Pollefeys
papers.affiliations: ETH Zurich, Google, Microsoft Spatial AI Lab
papers.intro: VidMap结合SLAM的时序约束和SfM的全局优化，通过密集匹配、时间感知的闭环检测和度量深度先验，实现对任意未标定长视频的度量和鲁棒重建。

papers.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
papers.authors: Siyao Li, Jiawei Gu, Shuai Liu, Kairui Hu, Zekun Li, Linjie Li, Chengcheng Tang, Po-Chen Wu, Ivan Shugurov, Lingni Ma, Michael Zollhoefer, Sizhe An, Abhay Mittal, Amy Zhao, Ranjay Krishna, Manling Li, Ziwei Liu, Chuan Guo
papers.affiliations: Meta, Nanyang Technological University, University of Washington, Brown University, Northwestern University
papers.intro: HumanCLAW 是一种将 VLM 的决策与运动执行解耦的评估框架，通过原子技能调用和半物理模拟器构建闭环全身动作循环，揭示当前前沿 VLM 在长时域导航-交互任务中因缺乏“具身自我意识”（embodied self-awareness）而成功率极低（最佳仅16.8%）。

papers.title: Explainable and Resource-Efficient Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs for Decision-Critical Applications
papers.authors: Piyush Jain, Kousik Dasgupta, Rajarshi Roy, Subarna Tripathi
papers.affiliations: Heritage Institute of Technology (Piyush Jain), Kalyani Government Engineering College (Kousik Dasgupta), IAIRO (Rajarshi Roy), Intel Corporation (Subarna Tripathi)
papers.intro: ByDeWay-V2 是一个无需训练、模块化的框架，通过将显式空间关系谓词与深度线索结合到提示中，增强了MLLM在资源受限场景下的空间推理能力和可解释性，并在VSR和BLINK基准上显著提升了F1分数。

papers.title: SeasonStereo: Robust Dense Stereo Matching for Multi-Date Satellite Imagery via Generative AI
papers.authors: Álvaro Díaz-Laureano, Roger Marí, Elías Masquil, Pablo Arias, Gabriele Facciolo
papers.affiliations: Eurecat, Multimedia Technologies, Barcelona, Spain; IIE, Facultad de Ingeniería, Universidad de la República, Uruguay; Dept. of Engineering, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Barcelona, Spain; Université Paris-Saclay, CNRS, ENS Paris-Saclay, Centre Borelli, France; Institut Universitaire de France
papers.intro: SeasonStereo 通过生成式AI合成带有可控季节性变化的立体影像对，并结合基础模型的零样本几何先验作为监督，训练出鲁棒的密集立体匹配模型，实现了不依赖LiDAR标签的多日期卫星影像视差估计，且精度与最优LiDAR监督模型相当。

papers.title: Towards Grounded GI Endoscopy VQA via Multi-Task Learning on Small VLMs
papers.authors: Itbaan Safwan, Ramail Khan, Muhammad Annas Shaikh, Muhammad Atif Tahir
papers.tags: visual question answering, multimodal learning, medical image
papers.affiliations: Institute of Business and Administration, Karachi, Pakistan
papers.intro: 本文提出一种多任务微调方法，在小型VLM上联合VQA、弱监督接地分割和术语无关的视觉描述任务，不仅提升了VQA准确率，还改善了模型内部答案token与图像相关区域的隐式对齐能力。

papers.title: Veritas++: Value-aware On-Policy Distillation for Perception-Enhanced AIGI Detection
papers.authors: Hao Tan, Jun Lan, Zichang Tan, Ajian Liu, Zijian Yu, Chuanbiao Song, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Jun Wan, Zhen Lei
papers.affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS), Institute of Automation Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA), Ant Group, Sangfor Technologies Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出Veritas++，通过感知导向学习（PoRL）显式增强MLLM对细粒度、语义和像素级异常的感知能力，并利用价值感知策略蒸馏（VaOPD）将增强的感知内化为推理能力，显著提升AIGI检测的泛化性能。

papers.title: FreqForcing: Autoregressive Long Video Generation via Spectral Self-Anchoring
papers.authors: Jiatong Li, Leo Liang, Linghe Kong, Yulun Zhang
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tencent HY Team
papers.intro: 提出FreqForcing，一种无需额外训练的框架，通过频谱自锚定（Spectral Self-Anchoring）在频域融合局部和锚定注意力输出，消除自回归视频生成中的低频谱能量漂移，将预训练于5秒片段的Self-Forcing模型扩展至稳定生成2分钟视频（24倍外推）。

papers.title: SciFigAlign: Scoring Scientific Figures by Fine-tuned Alignment of Visuals with Manuscript Evidence
papers.authors: Chuanzhi Xu, Zihan Deng, Huiqi Liang, Chengkun Yue, Zhanlin Cui, Pengfei Ye, Weidong Cai
papers.affiliations: The University of Sydney, The University of Hong Kong, Indiana University, The University of New South Wales, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出了SciFigAlign，一个通过细调多模态对齐（CLIP+SciBERT）与论文内排序损失来对科学图片的清晰度、相关性、信息量和结构进行连续评分的方法，在自建数据集上实现了相对于最佳LLM评判者59%的误差降低。

papers.title: Object Detection for Autonomous Driving in Chinese Rural Scenes: An Experimental Study on Real-Synthetic Data Mixing and Model Evaluation
papers.authors: Danning Zhu, Ziyan Lin, Jing Wu
papers.affiliations: Wuhan University of Technology
papers.intro: 本研究针对中国农村自动驾驶场景构建了一个包含14类对象的真实-合成混合目标检测数据集，并系统评估了13个主流检测器在不同真实-合成数据比例下的性能，发现适度注入合成数据（1:0.5比例）能有效提升检测性能，YOLO11m在mAP@0.5上达到0.758的最佳结果。

papers.title: Mitigating Compounding Error via Video Representation Regularization
papers.authors: Taiye Chen, Qi Zhang, Yisen Wang
papers.affiliations: Peking University
papers.intro: 本文发现自回归视频生成中的误差累积与隐藏表示的维度塌缩（dimensional collapse）密切相关，并提出一种轻量级训练正则化方法（视频表示正则化，VRR）来稳定表示、抑制误差累积，从而大幅提升长视频生成质量。

papers.title: Prior Directions: Why GUI Grounding Gets Locked in the Past
papers.authors: Weile Gong, Zijian Lu, Mingcai Chen, Yiping Zuo, Xin He, Weibei Fan
papers.affiliations: 南京邮电大学（Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications）
papers.intro: 该论文通过受控GUI定位实验发现，视觉锁定强度并不取决于先验诱导的表征变化幅度，而是取决于这些变化在晚期决策表征中是否沿一组跨样本重复出现的低维“先验方向”集中组织；移除沿该方向的成分可恢复视觉接地，而移除正交成分几乎无效。

papers.title: ViSAGE: Constructing Self-Correcting Memories for Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.authors: Xinkui Zhao, Enbo Chen, Yifan Zhang, Chang Liu, Guanjie Cheng, Naibo Wang, Yueshen Xu
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（Zhejiang University，杭州，中国）；西安电子科技大学（Xidian University，西安，中国）
papers.intro: ViSAGE 提出了一种视觉自我纠正智能体记忆框架，通过跨模态实体绑定、双向记忆精炼和多智能体交叉验证，构建具有实体一致性和自我修正能力的长视频理解记忆系统，并显著提升推理准确率。

papers.title: EgoSafe: A First-Person Mobile-Captured Benchmark for Visual Safety Understanding
papers.authors: Yuyun Chen, Tianao Li, TianQuan Feng, Cen Chen, Huiping Zhuang, Hao Peng, Ziqian Zeng
papers.affiliations: 华南理工大学（Yuyun Chen, Tianao Li, TianQuan Feng, Cen Chen, Huiping Zhuang, Ziqian Zeng）；北京航空航天大学（Hao Peng）
papers.intro: 本文提出EgoSafe-Bench——一个由3,000个第一人称移动拍摄视频片段和12,000个分层问答样本组成的安全理解基准，并设计了四层递进推理评估协议（HRE），系统揭示了LVLMs在表面感知与因果推理上的“推理解耦”现象。

papers.title: AgentGUI: An Interface for Observing and Steering Long-Running AI Agents
papers.authors: Xuan Zhao, Jiwoong Sohn, Qinyue Zheng, Michael Moor
papers.affiliations: ETH Zürich; ETH AI Center
papers.intro: AgentGUI是一个开源、本地托管的图形界面，用于观察和操控长时间运行的AI代理舰队，通过丰富的轨迹可视化、手动与自动化引导机制，显著加快用户理解代理轨迹的速度并提高小型本地代理的任务完成率。

papers.title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening
papers.authors: Syed Mhamudul Hasan, Anas AlSobeh, Hussein Zangoti, Abdur R. Shahid
papers.tags: multimodal learning, edge deployment, image classification
papers.affiliations: School of Computing, Southern Illinois University (Hasan, Shahid); Information Systems and Technology, Utah Valley University (AlSobeh); College of Engineering and Computer Science, Jazan University (Zangoti)
papers.intro: VetClaw 通过边缘设备（Raspberry Pi + 摄像头）捕获图像和可选的症状文本，利用服务器端视觉-语言模型进行零样本疾病分类，并由 OpenClaw 和 LangGraph 分离协调智能体交互与状态化工作流，将静态预测模型转化为安全感知的辅助筛查系统。

papers.title: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?
papers.authors: Abhishek Pillai, Samir Kumar Nayak, Yuan Chen
papers.tags: gui, multimodal learning, scene understanding, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA
papers.intro: 本文引入Desktop-Delta Bench（DDB），一个包含2,013个人工验证实例的离线步骤级桌面GUI状态转换理解基准，通过时间排序和单动作重建两个任务，诊断VLM在桌面CUA中对状态转换的理解能力，揭示了现有模型在验证、追踪和上下文控制方面的显著不足。

papers.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
papers.authors: Jiacong Xu, Hanwen Jiang, Zhixin Shu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Vishal M. Patel, Yiqun Mei
papers.affiliations: Adobe Research, Johns Hopkins University
papers.intro: Wonder是一个通用的视频世界模型，通过系统级协同设计相机控制（像素空间坐标场）、稀疏全保真记忆机制和改进的自回归蒸馏策略，实现实时（16 FPS）、相机可控的长期世界探索，同时支持图像和视频条件。

papers.title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation
papers.authors: Neta Shaul, Chao Liu, Arash Vahdat, Julius Berner
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA, Weizmann Institute of Science
papers.intro: 本文提出并行解码蒸馏（PDD），一种基于轨迹的简化、可扩展的蒸馏方法，通过在学习并行解码器一次网络评估中预测多个去噪步骤，实现了对预训练扩散/流匹配模型的快速推理，并支持可变函数评估次数（NFE），在图像和视频生成任务上达到SOTA性能且改善多样性。
